calc_entropy: calculate the entropy of a batch of torch tensor messages using frequency-based estimation
mutual_info: compute the mutual information between two torch tensor sequences xs and ys
compute_topsim: compute topographic similarity between meanings and messages using spearman correlation of pairwise distances
posdis: compute positional disentanglement score between attributes and messages using gap mutual information
bosdis: compute bag-of-symbols disentanglement score between attributes and messages with a given vocab size
